name: Commander's Insignia
oracle_text: Creatures you control get +1/+1 for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
blocked_sentences: Creatures you control get +1/+1 for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.

needs.what: admit the existing value leaf `commander_casts_this_game` (a player spec, here "you"; the 903.8 tally summed over the player's commanders from Player.commander_tax) into STATIC_VALUE_KEYS, so a `buff` static with affects {controller: you, types: [Creature]} can take power and toughness {"times": [{"const": 1}, {"commander_casts_this_game": "you"}]} or the leaf directly, recomputed continuously as the tally rises
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `commander_casts_this_game` (and `command_zone_casts_of`) exist only in value_keys for one-shot effects; static_value_keys omits them and the loader rejects any static magnitude leaf outside that set. `spells_cast_this_turn` is per-turn and counts every spell; `pump` on a trigger would wear off and miss creatures entering later, so the anthem needs the static form
